query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('source_pages',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_pages s JOIN public.books b ON b.id=s.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK' AND s.source_page BETWEEN 769 AND 773),'topics',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.topics t JOIN public.chapters c ON c.id=t.chapter_id JOIN public.books b ON b.id=c.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK' AND c.slug='europe' AND t.slug IN ('international-organizations-exam-boundary-769','international-organizations-exam-boundary-770','saarc-sapta-safta-boundary-771','saarc-oas-boundary-772','african-union-gcc-boundary-773')),'facts',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 769 AND 773),'notes',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 769 AND 773),'mcqs',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 769 AND 773),'mcq_options',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options o JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON m.id=o.mcq_id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 769 AND 773),'verifications',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 769 AND 773),'flashcards',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0769-0773:%'),'search_documents',0) AS batch_integrity LIMIT 1;
